visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a street view of a busy market alley with various stalls and parked scooters. A person in a purple shirt walks toward a food stall under a black awning while others stand in the distance. (2) Inside a public market entrance, pink celebratory banners hang from the ceiling over a walkway. A digital LED sign displays red text scrolling across the frame above an interior door. (3) A cook wearing a white mask and a purple long-sleeved shirt vigorously stirs noodles in a large metal wok in a stainless-steel kitchen. Steam billows from the hot pan as sliced vegetables are tossed together. (4) Close-up shot of hands in green latex gloves using metal tongs to portion out thin noodles from a large pile into small white ceramic bowls on a counter. (5) A detailed shot of a bowl of rice vermicelli topped with a glistening brown minced meat sauce and chopped green chives. A hand lifts the bowl to show it clearly against the shop background. (6) Metal chopsticks lift a large portion of the seasoned noodles and bean sprouts toward the camera lens, showcasing the steam and texture of the dish. (7) Various sliced meats including bright red pork and pink sausage are presented on a beige plate. A gloved hand slices more red meat on a large wooden cutting board with a heavy metal cleaver. (8) A slice of pink sausage is dipped into a small ceramic dish filled with vibrant red sauce, held by chopsticks in a close-up view. (9) A metal spoon is used to scoop up dark cubes of pig blood and sections of intestine from a clear broth containing green chives in a white bowl. (10) A close-up view of a thick, translucent meat soup being scooped with a spoon, revealing chunks of white meat, green cabbage leaves, and steam. (11) A wide shot of the '米粉明' stall with its red and yellow signage, steel preparation counters, and empty wooden dining tables with stools under indoor fluorescent lighting.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional food review to introduce a long-standing traditional rice vermicelli stall in Cishan, Kaohsiung. By combining fast-paced visual montages of the cooking process with energetic verbal endorsements and upbeat music, it aims to attract viewers to visit the '米粉明' stall for a nostalgic and affordable local breakfast experience.
